title: Software Engineer II
location: Bengaluru, KA, India; Chennai, TN, India
description:
The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.

We are seeking an experienced Engineer (Cybersecurity Analytics & Automation) who combines strong software engineering skills with a hands-on analytical mindset. This role will focus on identifying and investigating automated and malicious activity targeting internet-facing applications and APIs, including bot attacks, account takeover attempts, fraud patterns, API abuse, and other anomalous behavior.
The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) traffic and application security, along with the ability to analyze large-scale security and application datasets using Python, Elasticsearch, REST APIs, and related data-processing technologies.
This is a hands-on engineering and analytics role. The engineer will perform detailed manual investigations to understand emerging attack patterns and then translate repeatable analytical processes into scalable queries, detection logic, and Python-based automation.
The role also requires practical experience with Generative AI tools and AI-assisted engineering, including ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot, to accelerate investigation, data analysis, automation development, and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities:
 
· Investigate suspicious and malicious activity targeting internet-facing applications, websites, and APIs, with particular focus on automated bot activity and Layer 7 attacks.
· Perform hands-on analysis to identify malicious bots, credential stuffing, account takeover attempts, scraping, fraud patterns, API abuse, application-layer attacks, and anomalous network/application behavior.
· Analyze large-scale and diverse datasets, including:
- Application logs
- Web Application Firewall (WAF) events
- Bot management and bot detection signals
- API and network telemetry
- Authentication and account activity
- Fraud and security events
- Threat intelligence feeds and external data sources
· Develop and optimize Elasticsearch queries to investigate security events, correlate signals, identify behavioral patterns, and support detection use cases.
· Use Python and REST APIs to collect, enrich, correlate, process, and analyze security data from multiple systems.
· Identify repetitive manual investigation and analysis activities and convert them into reusable, scalable automation.
· Correlate signals across WAF, bot management, application, authentication, fraud, and threat intelligence platforms to distinguish legitimate users and automation from malicious activity.
· Work with large-scale datasets and distributed data-processing environments to identify trends and attack patterns that may not be visible from individual events.
· Evaluate and apply Generative AI to security analytics and engineering workflows, including investigation assistance, query generation, data analysis, code development, and automation.
· Effectively use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT to accelerate development while applying appropriate validation and secure engineering practices.
· Document investigation methodologies, detection logic, automation workflows, and operational procedures.
· Collaborate with cybersecurity, application engineering, fraud, infrastructure, and data teams to improve detection capabilities and strengthen protection of internet-facing services.

Minimum Qualifications:
· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
· 5+ years of software engineering, security engineering, security analytics, or related technical experience.
· Strong programming and automation skills using Python.
· Strong experience working with REST APIs and structured/semi-structured data.
· Hands-on experience with Elasticsearch, including querying and analyzing large datasets.
· Strong understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, Layer 7 protocols, web applications, and internet-facing application architectures.
· Ability to independently perform detailed investigations, formulate hypotheses, analyze data, and distinguish legitimate activity from suspicious or malicious behavior.
· Demonstrated ability to convert manual analytical processes into Python-based automation and repeatable engineering solutions.
· Practical experience using Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools, including ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or comparable technologies.
· Familiarity with modern software engineering practices, including Git, CI/CD, testing, code reviews, and secure development practices.
· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
 
Preferred Qualifications:
· Experience working on Docker, Kubernetes and Kafka.
· Experience analyzing large-scale application logs, security telemetry, network data, API traffic, or cybersecurity datasets.
· Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts related to bots, application security, API security, fraud, account takeover, and automated attacks.
· Experience with cloud security platforms such as Cloudflare, Akamai WAF/Bot manager, or comparable technologies.
· Experience with SIEM, security analytics, observability, or threat detection platforms.

title: Senior Software Engineer
location: India, Telangana, Hyderabad; India, Uttar Pradesh, Noida
description:
Overview
Overview
The Commerce Core Trust Platform Ambient Scoring team is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help define and build the next generation of systems that prevent, detect, and contain fraud, abuse, and compliance risk across Microsoft commerce experiences. You will lead significant architectural and engineering areas within a platform that continuously processes activity and entity changes, creates reputations and risk scores, detects suspicious behavior, and enables partner teams to take timely, proportionate action.
This role requires strong distributed-systems judgment, hands-on implementation, and end-to-end production ownership. You will translate ambiguous risk problems into scalable platform capabilities, guide consolidation of existing scoring systems, and raise engineering quality through design leadership, mentoring, and disciplined operation of mission-critical services.
Why this role matters
Fraud and compliance threats increasingly use automation, generative AI, compromised identities, synthetic entities, and coordinated behavior. The Ambient Scoring platform helps Microsoft move from isolated, point-in-time controls toward continuous understanding of customers, partners, accounts, transactions, and usage. By converting evolving signals into explainable reputations, scores, detections, and containment recommendations, the team helps protect customers and revenue while minimizing unnecessary friction for trusted entities.
You will shape reusable platform capabilities that allow Microsoft teams to onboard new risk scenarios faster, make better-informed decisions, and respond consistently across prevention, detection, and containment.

Responsibilities
- Own the architecture, implementation, deployment, and operation of significant Ambient Scoring subsystems, including signal ingestion, stateful processing, feature and reputation computation, rules and model inference, detections, APIs, and containment integration.
- Translate ambiguous fraud and compliance-risk scenarios into scalable platform designs, clear service boundaries, measurable outcomes, and phased execution plans.
- Lead design reviews and make informed trade-offs across latency, throughput, partitioning, state locality, consistency, replay, data retention, privacy, geographical boundaries, reliability, operational complexity, and cost.
- Design reusable processing abstractions that allow new scenarios to be expressed through configurable transformations, aggregations, features, reputations, rules, models, scoring graphs, and containment policies rather than bespoke pipelines.
- Drive modernization and consolidation of fragmented or legacy ambient-scoring services, identify opportunities to retire unused components, migrate scenarios to common architectures, and reduce redundant processing.
- Develop production-quality code and prototypes using C#, .NET, Azure Kubernetes Service, distributed-computation frameworks, Cosmos DB, Azure Data Lake Storage, Event Hubs, and other Azure Big Data capabilities as appropriate.
- Partner with data scientists to establish production-grade patterns for feature computation, offline and online consistency, model inference, experimentation, model or rule versioning, and measurement of precision, recall, false positives, and containment effectiveness.
- Establish clear contracts for fraud signals, score and detection consumption, explanation and evidence, feedback loops, and containment actions across partner teams.
- Define engineering standards for correctness, security, privacy, compliance, responsible AI, testability, telemetry, performance, safe deployment, rollback, disaster recovery, service-level objectives, and incident response.
- Use operational data to improve platform health and detection outcomes, including latency, freshness, availability, processing cost, false positives, missed detections, and time to onboard new scenarios.
- Lead investigations of complex production issues, coordinate live-site response across teams and time zones, and drive durable corrective actions.
- Mentor engineers through architecture discussions, code and design reviews, debugging, operational reviews, and hands-on technical guidance.
- Partner across Trust Platform, data, ML, commerce, security, compliance, and operational teams to align roadmaps, dependencies, ownership boundaries, and integration plans.
- Use AI-assisted engineering practices responsibly and help establish patterns that improve delivery speed without compromising correctness, privacy, security, reliability, or maintainability.

Qualifications
Required / Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 7+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, or Python OR equivalent experience.
- Demonstrated experience designing, delivering, and operating production cloud services or distributed data-processing systems with meaningful scale, reliability, and operational requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
- Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 7+ years technical engineering experience, OR Bachelor's Degree and 8+ years technical engineering experience, OR equivalent experience.
- Strong experience with distributed systems, streaming or batch data platforms, real-time decisioning, workflow orchestration, or cloud infrastructure.
- Experience with C#/.NET, Kubernetes/AKS, actor-based or distributed-computation frameworks, Cosmos DB, object or data-lake storage, Event Hubs, or comparable technologies.
- Deep understanding of one or more of partitioning, distributed state, data locality, scheduling, stream processing, storage formats, joins, replay, idempotency, consistency, fault tolerance, or recovery.
- Experience driving architecture from design and prototype through production deployment, live-site operation, measurement, and iterative improvement.
- Experience modernizing legacy systems or consolidating multiple services into shared, reusable platform capabilities.
- Familiarity with fraud, risk, trust, compliance, anomaly detection, reputation systems, feature platforms, ML inference, rules engines, or explainable decisioning.
- Ability to read and evaluate sophisticated industry or academic system designs, identify applicable principles, and adapt them to product and organizational constraints.
- Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, design reviews, cross-team influence, and delivery of ambiguous, multi-stage engineering initiatives.
Core competencies
- Computer science and software engineering fundamentals
- Distributed systems and cloud-native application development
- High-quality, maintainable, extensible, secure, and testable code
- Data processing, state management, APIs, and service integration
- Testing, telemetry, monitoring, troubleshooting, and live-site operations
- Security, privacy, compliance, accessibility, and responsible AI
- Clear communication, collaborative execution, and continuous learning
- Technical leadership, architectural judgment, mentoring, and influence across organizational boundaries
Who you'll work with
You will collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product managers, operations teams, and partner organizations across Microsoft. The team works across ambient scoring, data and signal exchange, assessments, reputation and scoring, containment actions, APIs, workflows, and support experiences. You will help connect centralized detection capabilities with domain expertise from partner teams so Microsoft can respond to fraud and compliance risks quickly and proportionately.
 
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

- Drive web performance through server-side rendering, hydration and rendering optimization, early data fetching, service workers and bundle-size reduction, with a focus on end-to-end latency and time to first answer.
- Integrate AI-generated answers into the search experience, including streaming responses, citations and source attribution, and graceful handling of partial or failed responses.
- Instrument features with telemetry, define success metrics, and run A/B experiments and staged rollouts to make data-driven product decisions.
- Own the reliability of the features you build, including monitoring, alerting, automated health checks and diagnosis of client issues such as authentication and host-loading failures.
- Participate in the team's on-call rotation, mitigating production incidents quickly and driving root-cause fixes so they do not recur.
- Partner closely with product managers, designers and backend search and relevance engineers to turn ambiguous ideas into polished, shippable experiences.
- Raise the engineering bar through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing and contributions to shared components and engineering practices.
- Use AI-assisted development tools and LLM-based techniques, such as automated analysis of user feedback and quality evaluation, to move faster and improve product quality.

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.- OR equivalent experience.

- Solid experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript.
- Solid web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, browser rendering, web performance and server-side rendering.
- Experience building and operating large-scale web applications used by a broad customer base.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

Agents and automations are only as good as the data they can reach. Data Fabric is UiPath’s unified data layer: it models and stores business data, federates data from external enterprise systems without copying it, and makes it available wherever it’s needed across UiPath.
We are looking for a Software Engineer II to build core parts of Data Fabric platform. Backend expertise is a must, and full stack experience is a plus. You will spend most of your time on services, APIs, and platform capabilities, and also contribute to the web experiences customers use.
At UiPath, we are tackling exciting challenges at the intersection of AI and intelligent agents. If you want to be part of it, we’d love to hear from you.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Passion for Building Scalable Solutions: Demonstrated ability to produce robust, well-tested, high-quality code while adhering to best practices in software development. Monitor what you ship in production, debug cross-service issues, and help resolve incidents.

 - Ownership and customer focus: Own your features from design to production, with guidance on larger designs. Keep the customer experience at the center of what you build.

 - Drive AI innovation: Build platform capabilities that let AI agents and automations discover and use business data through Data Fabric.

 - Backend and distributed systems: Design, build, and optimize scalable, secure services and APIs for the large-scale, multi-tenant Data Fabric platform, with a focus on performance, reliability, and high availability.

 - Contribute to the user experience: Build and improve web UI in Angular or React with TypeScript, and connect it to the backend services you build.

 - Team Collaboration: Work well in agile teams, contribute towards team alignment, and foster a collaborative environment where ideas and knowledge are freely exchanged.

 - Use AI tools well: Use AI tools and coding agents for development (for example, code generation, testing, debugging, and documentation), while keeping a high engineering quality bar.

 - Effective Communication Skills: Clearly articulate technical ideas, design decisions, and solutions to diverse audiences in both written and verbal formats while driving consensus.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

 - 3 to 5 years of software engineering experience building backend or full stack production services.

 - Strong skills in a backend language such as C# (.NET) or Java, and a willingness to learn new ones.

 - A builder's mindset and a bias for action: you take initiative, turn ideas into working software quickly, and stay comfortable with ambiguity.

 - Curiosity about how AI is reshaping software development and the systems we build.

 - Solid grasp of object-oriented programming, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, multithreading, asynchronous programming, and system design basics.

 - Experience with relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL, including schema design and query performance.

 - Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

 - Familiarity with CI/CD, agile development, and writing automated tests.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working with globally distributed teams.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with front-end development using TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with React or Angular.

 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other container technologies.

 - Familiarity with GraphQL or data mesh architectures.

 - Understanding of LLMs and the AI powered API automation.

 - Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Azure Monitor.

#LI-VR1

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. title: Full Stack Senior Developer
description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.

By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.

From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.

About the Role
We are building an enterprise application for the prime brokerage domain. The role involves developing full stack services with Java and Python, deploying applications to Kubernetes, and supporting application monitoring.
We’re looking for someone who can understand business requirements, especially capital market needs, and work closely with product design, QA, and engineering teams to deliver reliable software.
Key Responsibilities
- Understand business requirements and translate domain-specific needs into software solutions.
- Use agentic development approaches, such as spec-driven development and BMAD.
- Design, develop, and maintain applications using Java, Spring Boot, React, and Python.
- Build and integrate REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven services.
- Develop responsive user interfaces using React, ES6, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
- Deploy and support applications running in Docker containers on Kubernetes.
- Monitor applications and help diagnose issues across frontend, backend, and integration layers.
- Participate in peer code reviews and collaborate throughout the software development lifecycle.

Required Skills and Experience
- Strong knowledge of Java 21, Spring Boot, Kafka, microservices, and event-driven architecture.
- Hands-on experience with Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, and asynchronous programming.
- Familiarity with agentic development approaches, including spec-driven development.
- Frontend development experience with React, ES, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
- Experience with GitHub repositories, GitHub Actions, and peer code reviews.
- Practice of using design principle and design patterns
- Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Experience writing unit tests using JUnit 5.
- Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams.
- Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
- Good understanding of architecture and design.
Qualifications
- 8+ years of software development experience.
- A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- Experience in the capital markets domain. Prime brokerage experience is preferred.

title: DevFest 2027 Senior Software Engineer
description:
Location Details: Remote, India

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. 

Join Our Team...
We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Infrastructure Management and Automation team. In this role, you’ll help shape and build the tools, platforms, and automation that power and manage GoDaddy’s growing infrastructure footprint while leading the design of scalable solutions to complex operational challenges.
Our infrastructure platform empowers GoDaddy engineers to help small business customers start, grow, and run their ventures. GoDaddy teams rely on our infrastructure solutions every day, whether for development workflows or hosting production workloads at global scale. If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, designing scalable systems, influencing technical direction, and improving how infrastructure is managed and automated, we’d love to hear from you!

What you'll get to do...

- Lead the design and evolution of GoDaddy’s next generation of infrastructure management platforms and automation systems, taking ownership of complex technical areas from design through delivery and operation

- Leverage modern engineering practices and AI-assisted development workflows to rapidly design, build, and deliver scalable internal tooling and automation

- Design and build reliable services and integrations across infrastructure platforms and operational systems, including provisioning, networking, IPAM, DNS, CMDB, and asset management workflows

- Partner with engineering and operations teams to identify opportunities, shape technical solutions, and improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, utilization, and operational efficiency

- Drive architectural and engineering decisions for ambiguous or cross-cutting infrastructure problems, balancing near-term delivery with reusable patterns and long-term maintainability

- Mentor and support other engineers, establish strong engineering patterns and practices, and help raise the technical quality of solutions across the team

Your experience should include...

- 7+ years of software engineering experience building full stack solutions using Python and JavaScript

- Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, distributed system concepts, and system/performance optimization

- Hands-on experience designing, developing, and consuming RESTful APIs and services, with a solid grasp of web fundamentals (HTTP, JSON, authentication, etc.)

- Experience designing and delivering complex software systems or automation platforms that integrate across multiple services, data sources, or infrastructure domains

- Experience working with relational databases (MySQL or similar), data stores (Redis or similar), source control (Git), and CI/CD tooling

- Experience making technical design decisions, working through ambiguity, and driving solutions from initial problem definition through production delivery and operational support

- Experience using AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Cursor, or similar) as part of day-to-day engineering workflows

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing technical direction and partnering effectively across engineering and operational teams

You might also have...

- Experience with configuration management and infrastructure automation tools (Ansible, Puppet, SaltStack, or similar technologies)

- Experience with enterprise workflow and infrastructure management platforms (ServiceNow, CMDB/asset management, or workflow automation platforms)

- Exposure to cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments (preferably AWS)

- Experience building integrations across infrastructure platforms and operational systems (provisioning, networking, IPAM, DNS, or asset management tooling)

- Familiarity with large-scale infrastructure orchestration, virtualization, and operational workflows (OpenStack, VMware, or similar technologies)

- Experience with observability, monitoring, or operational telemetry platforms and using data to improve reliability and efficiency

- Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing technical designs, and creating reusable engineering patterns that can be adopted beyond a single feature or project

- Passion for solving complex infrastructure and distributed systems challenges while building scalable, reliable solutions

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

We've got your back...  We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

About us... GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us. 

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Refer to our full EEO policy.

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com. 

GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership while developing strategic approaches and engineering principles that improve the stability, scalability, performance, and efficiency of our products and services.

You will lead and influence multiple teams and technical initiatives, solve open-ended and complex engineering problems, and help shape the long-term technical direction of the platform.

Your Mission

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Develop a deep understanding of the overall system and be able to work across components when needed, including diving into code, debugging critical issues, and helping teams resolve complex technical problems.

- Provide technical leadership across multiple projects and initiatives, guiding engineers through architecture, design, implementation, and delivery.

- Own the technical direction of large components and influence broader product and engineering decisions through deep subject-matter expertise.

- Think both strategically and tactically, balancing immediate engineering needs with long-term technical and company goals.

- Translate long-term strategic goals into a technical path that can be delivered progressively across multiple releases and versions.

- Take ownership of open-ended technical problems and drive them from ambiguity through to practical, scalable solutions.

- Participate in and support technical initiatives outside your immediate area of responsibility.

Hands-on Engineering

- Remain hands-on with designing, coding, debugging, maintaining, and upgrading software.

- Build and evolve complex web systems and backend services using technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and microservices.

- Investigate complex software and production issues, identify root causes, and make the necessary improvements to ensure reliability and optimal performance.

- Improve the performance, stability, scalability, and maintainability of existing software.

- Work with testing teams to develop effective performance test plans and test cases.

- Evaluate and recommend technologies, engineering approaches, and tools that can improve developer productivity and overall technical capabilities.

Product & Customer Impact

- Partner with Product and other stakeholders to understand product requirements, customer needs, and technical constraints.

- Use strong technical and domain knowledge to influence product direction and internal technical decisions.

- Research and gather relevant product and technical information and support the development of specifications and requirements.

- Put customers first when making technical decisions and help establish practical short-term priorities without losing sight of the long-term technical strategy.

Cross-Team Influence & Mentorship

- Build strong relationships within your team and across the organization to drive complex technical initiatives forward.

- Understand different technical and business perspectives and help teams reach sound conclusions in a timely and respectful manner.

- Provide high-level technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and help strengthen engineering capability across the organization.

- Provide technical leadership to engineers working on complex projects, including guiding teams of 3–4 or more contributors where appropriate.

- Support the development and training of other engineers through mentoring, design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing.

- Regularly participate in team and cross-functional discussions to identify problems, brainstorm approaches, and drive solutions.

- Continuously raise the technical bar and improve the company’s overall engineering capability.

You Are

- A highly capable technical leader with strong hands-on software engineering expertise.

- Experienced in solving complex, ambiguous engineering problems and making sound technical decisions.

- Strong in documentation, analytical thinking, and structured problem solving.

- An effective communicator who can work across engineering, product, testing, and other functions.

- Able to influence technical direction without relying solely on formal authority.

- Highly organized, with demonstrated technical leadership skills.

- Experienced in modern software development methodologies and engineering practices.

- Experienced in designing and building complex, scalable web systems.

Technical Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

- 13+ years of relevant hands-on software engineering experience, including substantial experience with Java-based development.

- Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and microservices.

- Proven experience designing, coding, debugging, and evolving complex software systems.

- Experience making architecture and design decisions for systems that need to remain scalable, reliable, maintainable, and performant.

Extra Awesome

- Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical or business field.

- Experience designing and running web services at significant scale.

- Experience solving complex performance, scalability, reliability, or distributed-system challenges.

- Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams or major areas of a product.

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources 

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube

- @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You 

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
description:

- Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:
- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).

- Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

Collaboration & Partnership:
- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

Problem Solving:
- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

Continuous Learning:
- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.

Continuous Improvement:
- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
. 

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer.

About the job

This position will be part of a team of talented engineers within our Commerce Platform Team, who build services and products that operate at a massive scale. This platform is central to Twilio's core business as it is responsible for managing the billing lifecycle and payment experience for our customers, while also acting as a gateway for discovering and selling our products. Billing is going through a transformational journey, and we are introducing new and exciting capabilities. The engineer in this role will be part of a team that focuses on the control plane, billing experience and account lifecycle management.=

The successful candidate will design, build, and operate core billing platform services that help transition our platform and our customers to the next generation architecture. These services work for all Twilio customers, regardless of their scale and billing complexity.

The ideal candidate will build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software that complies with high levels of coding standards and technical design. This is to build and integrate services that continuously improve our ability to provide products to customers while simultaneously delivering industry leading availability. We do this by leveraging technologies that include AWS cloud infrastructure and APIs, Apache Kafka, Rest APIs (OpenAPI compliance), while also building our own services.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

- Improve your knowledge of highly available and scalable distributed systems and use this knowledge to build new features into our platform.

- Design, implement, and operate both new features on our current services as well as new services that will be built from scratch.

- Leverage your excellent communication and written skills to articulate the "why" of the solution you are proposing, and have a good understanding of your team’s priorities and the customer impact.

- Troubleshoot and fix operational issues and have the opportunity to improve the troubleshooting procedures and tools.

- Execute full software development life cycle (SDLC).

- Develop flowcharts and documentation to identify solutions.

- Write well-designed, testable code.

- Document and maintain software functionality.

- Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade existing systems.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

- 0-2 years of work experience building highly scalable products.

- Experience of programming in object-oriented language (Java or similar) with clean code practices.

- Knowledge in Object-Oriented Programming with a successful track record.

- Experience with relational and non-relational databases.

- Collaborating with internal/external teams/engineers and fostering an inclusive environment, where all points of view are welcomed and encouraged.

- Self driven - you take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get your tasks to completion.

- Clear written and spoken communication skills.

- Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Desired:

- 

- Familiarity in Cloud Solutions, AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD pipelines, Testing & Automation. 

- Experience delivering high levels of observability and proficiency in improving early warning systems, for example: has worked with Grafana/DataDog/Prometheus.

- Experience with on-call support for mission-critical customer systems.

- Experience optimizing and debugging SQL queries.

- Experience working on customer-facing applications.

- Good debugging skills on production systems.

- Proficient in Linux and containerization with Kubernetes.

- Nice to have skills: gRPC, Python, Typescript, React, Apache Kafka.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
. 

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
. 

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
. 

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Senior SDE- Kernel Engineer, SSG
description:

- Develop and modify Board Support Package (BSP) components: This includes bootloaders (TF-A, OP-TEE, SCP, U-Boot), device drivers, kernel modules, and device tree support.
- Collaborate with architecture teams to define and implement innovative silicon features.
- Perform initial silicon and platform bring-up in both pre-silicon and post-silicon environments.
- Debug and root-cause complex issues across hardware and software interfaces.
- Partner with cross-functional teams to productize silicon solutions and ensure successful product delivery.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS)
description:
Can a compliance platform onboard each new team through configuration, and still keep every team's data, permissions, and workflows separate? How do you let an artificial intelligence (AI) agent scan regulatory change or test a control, and still show an auditor every source and approval behind its output? What does it take to keep a platform that compliance teams depend on secure, available, and fast to change?

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE) to join the Engineering team within Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS). Our team builds the Signal Suite, the platform RCS uses to track regulatory change, assess risks and controls, run assurance testing, and manage issues to closure. Payments regulatory compliance is our core domain. RCS's north star is that compliance is never the step that delays a financial product launch, a response to regulatory change, or a market expansion. We are turning the Signal Suite from a compliance repository into the system where compliance work runs end to end. Automation takes on the volume, so experts focus on regulatory interpretation and risk judgment.

You design and build that next stage across 3 areas: the multi-tenant platform, the generative AI (GenAI) layer and its AI agents, and the engineering foundation. The platform moves to a configuration-driven design that keeps each tenant's data and access separate in every layer. The AI agents you build run steps of the compliance lifecycle, and compliance experts supervise and approve their work. The engineering foundation covers reliability, security, and release practices. Every output faces internal audit and regulatory examination, so traceability is part of the product.

As a Senior SDE, you own each problem from definition to production. You shape the requirements with product managers and Compliance Officers, write the design, build and test the services, and operate them. You make and document the trade-offs between tenant isolation, cost, latency, and delivery speed. You mentor engineers and influence technical direction across teams you do not manage. Our services run on Amazon Web Services (AWS), including AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB. Your partners also include data engineers and business intelligence engineers across RCS.

The successful candidate treats an auditor's question as a design requirement and proves an idea with a working prototype before scaling it.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead the architecture of the Signal Suite as a configuration-driven, multi-tenant platform, and build the services, APIs, and data models that keep each tenant's data and access separate
• Design and build the GenAI layer and the AI agents that work across Signal Suite modules, from regulatory change scanning to risk assessment and assurance testing
• Create the guardrails that let compliance experts supervise each agent: expert-labeled evaluation sets, release criteria, approval steps, and a record of the sources behind every output
• Write and review production code for complex components, with AI-assisted development, automated tests, and deployment pipelines that keep every change shippable
• Define the technical roadmap for your area, and record each architecture trade-off and its reason in a design document
• Build security into every design, with least-privilege access, encryption of each tenant's data, and audit logs that show who changed what and when
• Own the operational health of the services you build, from monitoring and alarms to on-call runbooks and incident reviews whose actions remove the root cause
• Turn regulatory requirements into designs with product managers and Compliance Officers, and align partner teams across RCS through architecture reviews
• Mentor SDEs through design and code reviews, set the engineering standards the team builds to, and take part in hiring

About the team
Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) serves as a crucial safeguard for Amazon's buyers, brands, and selling partners while ensuring business teams meet their regulatory obligations. RCS operates as the second line of defense under the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model, providing specialized oversight, monitoring, and expertise while setting policies and procedures that guide Amazon's compliance framework.

RCS's mission is to apply specialist industry insights and Amazon's unique approach to scale through technology, delighting customers through tailored compliance solutions. Our work spans multiple critical areas, including:
• Streamlined license acquisition that enables Amazon's financial services expansion
• Management of existing business risks across the organization
• Comprehensive governance, risk, and assurance services
• Innovative solutions such as Compliance as a Service (CaaS)
• A proactive, intelligence-led framework for compliance operations

description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:
Job Summary
What you need to know about the role
As a Senior Backend Software Engineer, you will own the design and reliability of Java services across checkout, commerce, identity and money movement for PayPal POS. You will lead the technical side of taking ownership of these services from our Sweden team: shape the plan, mentor engineers, and be the person we trust with critical payment and financial flows.

Meet our team
Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned.
We are a growing engineering team in Bangalore working closely with colleagues in Sweden, who built much of the platform.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities: 
- Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.
- Advises immediate management on project-level issues
- Guides junior engineers
- Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices
- Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

Minimum Qualifications:
- 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Your way to impact
- Set the technical direction for services spanning checkout, commerce, identity and money movement.
- Reduce operational and financial risk in payment, settlement and payout flows through better design, automation and observability.
- Lead the Zettle-to-PayPal convergence work on the backend, including the move of legacy merchants onto PayPal One Identity and the integration with PayPal core payments through the TAP API.
- Grow the team: mentor engineers, review designs, and make knowledge transfer from Sweden stick.
Your day to day
- Lead design and delivery of larger changes such as new payment flows, integrations and migrations, writing clear design documents and decision records.
- Act as incident commander for your domain; run post-incident reviews and drive the fixes.
- Own SLOs, alerting and capacity for your services; work with SRE and PayPal platform teams.
- Review code and designs for the team, and coach engineers at CL5 and below.
- Partner with product, Finance, security and compliance on payments, settlement, payouts and reconciliation.
- Run knowledge-transfer sessions with Sweden and ensure every critical service has at least two people who can operate it.
 
What do you need to bring
- 4 to7 years of software engineering experience, with deep Java expertise and a record of owning production services.
- Proven design of distributed, event-driven systems on AWS, including multi-region and failure-mode thinking.
- Strong knowledge of payments: authorization, capture, refunds, clearing, settlement, chargebacks and reconciliation. Experience with ledgers, payouts or bank connectivity is a strong plus.
- Working knowledge of PCI DSS scope, key management and secure access to sensitive data.
- Experience leading cross-team technical work, mentoring, and handling incidents as lead.
- Nice to have: GraphQL federation, OAuth and identity migrations, PSD2/SCA, EU payment schemes (such as Swish or Vipps).
- Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden.
- A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records.
- Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product.

title: Software Development Engineer - II
description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, powering merchants across checkout optimisation, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables 15,000+ merchants globally, processes ~$2 billion in GMV, and is rapidly scaling across India, the UK, Europe, and the US. Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments, GoKwik has raised $68 million in funding, including a $13 million growth round in June 2025, and is building AI-powered infrastructure to shape the future of eCommerce.

Why This Role Matters

As a Software Development Engineer - II, you'll build and scale the backend systems that power GoKwik's checkout, payments, and post-purchase products. You'll own services end-to-end, make architectural decisions that improve platform reliability and performance, and mentor engineers while driving complex technical initiatives. The systems you build directly influence merchant conversions, customer experience, and platform scalability.

What You'll Own

- Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and NestJS, with Go for selected services.
- Build and optimize distributed systems using PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Kafka.
- Own event-driven architectures, ensuring high throughput, reliability, fault tolerance, and scalability.
- Drive architectural decisions, document technical trade-offs, and improve system design across services.
- Deliver end-to-end features, contributing to frontend development in React or Svelte where required.
- Strengthen CI/CD pipelines, observability, monitoring, and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
- Debug production issues, improve system performance, and ensure high service reliability.
- Review code, mentor Associate Engineers and SDE I engineers, and elevate engineering standards across the team.
- Take ownership of ambiguous technical problems and independently drive them from design through production deployment.

Who You Are

- Strong backend engineering experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and NestJS.
- Working knowledge of Go or the willingness to learn and build production services with it.
- Strong understanding of PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and distributed data systems.
- Experience designing and scaling event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging systems.
- Comfortable working across the stack, including frontend technologies such as React or Svelte.
- Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, maintainability, and software architecture principles.
- Experience mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and driving engineering best practices.
- Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Why GoKwik

At GoKwik, you'll solve engineering challenges at massive scale while building products that power thousands of merchants and millions of shoppers. You'll work alongside exceptional engineers, influence technical direction, mentor growing teams, and own systems that have a direct business impact. If you're looking for autonomy, technical depth, and the opportunity to build category-defining products, GoKwik is the place to do it.

Full-Stack Web Developer

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

You Are

You are an early-career developer who has moved past tutorials and built things that actually run in production or close to it. You know the difference between code that works on your laptop and code that someone else can deploy, maintain, and extend six months later. When something breaks, you dig in. When requirements are unclear, you ask the right questions instead of guessing or waiting.

You have written enough JavaScript and TypeScript to know when a component is getting too complicated, and you care about that. Working across front-end, back-end, and database layers does not intimidate you because you have done it before, even if not at scale. You learn by building, not by collecting certifications.

Small teams appeal to you because your work is visible and your contributions matter from day one. You want to be in a place where asking good questions is valued, where senior engineers actually review your code and explain the why, and where you can see the impact of what you ship. At Synopsys, you will work on internal platforms that employees across the company depend on, and the team you join operates like a high-trust startup inside a global organization.

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and maintain full-stack web applications using the PANN stack: PostgreSQL, Angular, NestJS, and Node.js
- Implement features across the entire application layer, from UI components in Angular to API endpoints in NestJS to database schema changes in PostgreSQL
- Work with Prisma ORM to model data, manage migrations, and write clean database access logic
- Collaborate with cybersecurity, engineering, and business teams to translate requirements into working software that solves real problems
- Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and orchestrate services in environments managed with Kubernetes, Nginx, and Apache
- Contribute to AI-enabled features including retrieval-augmented generation workflows, prompt engineering, and automation that pulls from internal knowledge repositories
- Support CI/CD pipelines and help maintain production systems through monitoring, debugging, and performance tuning

The Impact You Will Have

- Your code will power internal platforms used daily by employees across Synopsys to get work done faster and more securely
- You will reduce manual effort and operational overhead by automating repetitive workflows and integrating disconnected systems
- The features you build will improve how teams access organizational knowledge, make decisions, and collaborate across functions
- Your contributions will help scale cybersecurity, compliance, and engineering operations across a 30,000-person global organization
- You will enable better data-driven decision-making by building intuitive interfaces that surface the right information at the right time
- Working in a small, high-impact team means your individual work will be visible and valued, not lost in a backlog
- You will help lay the foundation for scalable solutions that can be adopted across multiple business units as the platform grows

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent hands-on experience building and shipping web applications
- 2 to 4 years of experience developing full-stack web applications, though stronger evidence of end-to-end delivery can matter more than years
- Hands-on experience with the PANN technology stack: PostgreSQL, Angular, NestJS, and Node.js in real projects, not just side experiments
- Solid working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and REST API design
- Experience using Prisma or a comparable ORM for data modeling, schema migrations, and database access patterns
- Familiarity with Docker for containerization and exposure to Kubernetes, Nginx, or Apache in deployment contexts
- Practical exposure to AI technologies such as large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or automation workflows, whether through work, coursework, or personal projects
- Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, testing methodologies, and secure coding principles
- Experience integrating systems through APIs and working with both relational and non-relational databases
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, you can explain what you built, why you built it that way, and what tradeoffs you made

Who You Are

- You take ownership of your work and follow through, even when it means asking for help or clarification along the way
- When you encounter a problem you do not immediately know how to solve, you research, test, and ask targeted questions instead of spinning or guessing
- You write code with the next person in mind, whether that is a teammate doing a review or your future self debugging at 3pm on a Tuesday
- You are comfortable working in a small team where accountability is high and your contributions are visible from day one
- Curiosity drives you, especially around emerging technologies like AI, and you are eager to apply them to solve real business problems, not just experiment
- You can collaborate effectively with people outside engineering, translating technical constraints into language that product and business stakeholders actually understand
- You care about user experience and think through how the features you build will actually be used, not just whether they technically function
- Results matter to you more than process for its own sake, you want to ship things that work and make a measurable difference

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your team develops platforms and capabilities that help scale cybersecurity, compliance, engineering, and business operations across Synopsys. The team operates with a startup mindset, focusing on high-impact initiatives, rapid execution, and practical innovation. You will work closely with a small group of technical and domain experts to build solutions that enable automation, knowledge management, and data-driven decision making. Individual contributions are highly visible, and you will have direct access to senior engineers who will review your work, explain tradeoffs, and help you grow.

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

description:
Who We Are

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves. Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

About The Role

Platform Science is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Core Product Development team in Chennai. In this role, you will drive Full Stack Development initiatives across our edge-to-cloud IoT environment.

You will work with a robust engineering stack focused on NodeJS, TypeScript, Java, Microservices, and MySQL to build highly scalable, resilient features. This role is a perfect fit for a seasoned engineer who enjoys solving complex architectural challenges, working within an automated agile workflow, and delivering clean, high-performance code.

Essential Responsibilities

- Full-Lifecycle Engineering: Participate in the complete product development lifecycle, including technical analysis, architecture, system design, coding, unit integration, and system testing. 
- Sustaining & Enhancement: Provide ongoing sustaining support to core software products, driving end-to-end feature enhancements and codebase health. 
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product Management, Technical Architects, and fellow Development Engineers to confirm, refine, and track technical requirements from concept to delivery. 
- Agile Execution: Act as a core member of an agile engineering squad utilizing Scrum methodologies, actively participating in team sprint planning and execution. 
- Transparent Communication: Maintain regular, transparent communication regarding development progress, technical trade-offs, and project obstacles. 
- Knowledge Sharing: Proactively collaborate with teammates, seeking assistance when navigating technical hurdles and providing mentorship and support back to others. 

Target Capabilities & Skills

- Experience: 5-6 years of professional experience developing robust web applications and data systems. 
- Core Languages: Strong, production-level coding skills in NodeJS, TypeScript, and Java. 
- Backend Ecosystem: Excellent working knowledge of the Spring Framework, Spring MVC, and Hibernate/JPA.

- Testing Rigor: Experience writing automated unit tests using industry frameworks (e.g., Mocha, Chai, Jest, Jasmine, AVA, or JUnit). 
- Release & DevOps: Hands-on experience with Continuous Integration and Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, GitHub branching strategies, and modern release management procedures.
