title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce data and growth company headquartered in the Silicon Slopes tech hub in Lehi, Utah, with global offices in Europe, China, Australia, the Middle East, and Canada. Named to the Inc. 500 list of the fastest-growing companies in the US, Pattern has made its mark in the industry. Some of the biggest consumer brands - including Skullcandy, Nestle, Clorox, Kong, Panasonic, Tumi, and PopSockets - trust Pattern with their business, and Pattern has recruited talent from Amazon, eBay, Adobe, PepsiCo, Apple, Google, and Oracle.

Pattern values data and the engineering required to take full advantage of it. As a Senior Software Engineer on the AI Platforms team, you will build the systems that turn Pattern's data into automated, accountable action for our brand partners.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities 

- Platform services: design, build and run the backend services that receive events, track cases, decide whether an agent should run, and resume work when a person responds. 
- Correctness: own the platform's correctness guarantees:
- idempotency; 
- deduplication of repeated signals; 
- locking against concurrent runs; 
- recovery from crashed or stuck runs; 
- a complete audit trail of what each agent did. 
- Agents: build and evolve agents that follow business SOPs. Decide which steps belong in deterministic code, which need the model's judgement, and which must stay with a person. 
- Tools: build MCP tool servers that give agents safe, well-described access to internal data and services, with clear input and output schemas. 
- Human-in-the-loop: integrate approval flows: request approvals, verify signed callbacks, handle partial approval, rejection and expiry, and make sure only approved work is executed. 
- Evaluations: write evals for agents and tools (golden datasets, regression suites, trace review) and use them as the gate for shipping prompt, model and tool changes. 
- Observability and cost: instrument services and agents with tracing, metrics and logs. Track model cost per case, and keep agents from running when nothing has changed. 
- Safety: apply guardrails, including:
- treating external content as untrusted input; 
- keeping money and policy rules in code, not in prompts; 
- never automating systems Pattern policy forbids. 
- Cross-team work: make changes across service boundaries with the teams that own sensors, task management, approvals and the Pi web app, including in a second language (Python or Ruby on Rails) when the work requires it. 
- Requirements: translate business requirements (SOPs, approval rules, escalation paths) into clear designs, tickets and runnable systems. 
- Production support: support production, including on-call triage when an automation misbehaves. 
- Leadership (Senior): mentor other engineers, review their designs and code, and help set engineering standards for AI work on the team. 

What We Expect

 Senior Software Engineer (5-7 years) 

- 3+ years of production experience in your primary backend language. 
- Designs new components end to end, such as the case-tracking service, and takes ambiguous problems to a clear design. 
- Owns a production service, including being on call. 
- Has shipped and measured an LLM-powered feature they owned. 
- Mentors engineers and reviews designs and code. 

Required Qualifications 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
- 5-7 years of professional software engineering experience, mostly on backend systems. 
- Primary skill set (one of the following): 
- TypeScript and Python , with production experience in TypeScript (3+ years) and solid working experience in Python; or 
- TypeScript and Ruby on Rails , with production experience in either (3+ years) and solid working experience in the other. 

You should be comfortable reading and making changes in the language you use less.

- Experience designing APIs and webhooks, including authentication and signature verification. 
- Has shipped at least one LLM-powered feature in production: tool or function calling, structured outputs, and a way to measure whether it works. 
- Comfort with AWS (ECS or containers, S3, IAM at minimum) and with Docker. 
- Production ownership,monitoring, alerting, incident response and root-cause analysis. 
- Excellent engineering practice: version control, code review, automated testing, and small, reviewable changes. 
- Strong written and spoken communication, including turning ambiguous business processes into clear technical designs. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with PostgreSQL in production: data modelling, transactions, indexing, and concurrency control (row locking, optimistic versioning, unique constraints). 
- Experience with background jobs and queues (for example BullMQ, Sidekiq, Celery, SQS or Kafka), including retries, idempotency and dead-letter handling. 
- Experience building agents or agent platforms: multi-step workflows, human approval steps, memory or state across runs. 
- Experience building or consuming MCP servers, or similar tool-integration layers. 
- Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as Opik, Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust or Promptfoo. 
- Familiarity with agent frameworks and SDKs (for example the Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK or LangGraph), and with LLM gateways or routers. 
- Experience with durable workflow or event-driven patterns: transactional outbox, leases, Temporal, Step Functions or event sourcing. 
- Experience with OpenTelemetry tracing. 
- eCommerce or marketplace domain experience (Amazon, Walmart, Shopify or similar). 
- Experience working productively with AI coding agents (for example Claude Code) on a large existing codebase. 

Your first 90 days 

- Days 1-30: 
- Learn the platform end to end: follow one automation from sensor detection to approved, completed work. 
- Ship small fixes in the agents platform and a tool server. 
- Be able to explain how a repeat signal is prevented from creating duplicate work. 
- Days 31-60: 
- Own a component, such as part of the case-tracking service, an approval integration or a set of MCP tools. 
- Add an evaluation suite that catches a real regression.

title: Tech Lead
description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Minimum qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 11 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node.js or Python, including 5 years of architecture across multiple systems.
- 3 years of experience owning engineering standards adopted beyond your own team, and mentoring senior engineers.
- Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with engineering, product and business stakeholders in other regions.
- Backend language and craft. You are an expert in TypeScript with Node.js or in Python, and a practitioner in the other. You set our backend and frontend coding patterns, framework choices and upgrade path, and you are a practitioner in at least two other crafts.
- React and frontend. You set our full-stack conventions across teams: where logic lives, how APIs serve user interfaces, and how shared components are built and maintained.
- APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI from first principles: resource modelling, HTTP semantics, pagination, consistent error formats, versioning, idempotency and rate limiting. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and how to evolve both without breaking consumers. You set our API and serialisation standards and decide on exceptions.
- Data. You are fluent in PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions and zero-downtime migrations with Prisma, TypeORM or SQLAlchemy. You design DynamoDB and MongoDB models around access patterns, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload. You own our data-architecture standards, including how datastores are introduced and retired.
- Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design event-driven systems on queues and streams such as SQS, Kafka and BullMQ or Celery, using retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent consumers so that at-least-once delivery is safe. You know the outbox and saga patterns and when orchestration is better than choreography. You own our reference architecture for reliability.
- Cloud and platform. You have built and run production services on AWS or GCP, both as Lambda functions and as Kubernetes workloads, and you understand the trade-offs between them: cold starts, concurrency, cost, capacity and deployment risk. You define infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK and release safely with canary and blue/green deployments. With Platform Engineering, you decide when we use serverless and when we use Kubernetes, and you set the reference architectures for both.
- Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and expect every team to do the same. You build balanced test suites: unit tests with Jest, Vitest or pytest, integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests with Pact, and Playwright end-to-end tests that gate releases. You set our quality standard and approve any exceptions to it.
- Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry and use Datadog and CloudWatch to find problems before users do. You profile with flame graphs, measure p95 and p99 latency, and fix causes rather than symptoms. You set our standards for SLOs, dashboards, alerting and performance budgets, and you lead the hardest incidents to their root cause.
- Security and identity. You write secure code by default and apply the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10 in practice. You design authentication and authorisation with OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, secure service-to-service traffic with mTLS and workload identity, and integrate identity providers such as Okta, Keycloak and Cognito. You set our identity and security standards and own security reviews with the Security team
- Architecture and design. You design systems that span many services and teams, and you write architecture decision records that make the trade-offs explicit. You own our technical roadmap and style guide, act as the arbiter on standards, and decide on evidence rather than authority. You are able to trace many symptoms back to a single root cause and fix it once.
- Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow, small changes and feature flags, and you know CI/CD pipelines inside out. You have led deprecations and migrations all the way to switching the old system off. You set our Git, CI/CD and dependency policies, and you make large-scale change routine rather than exceptional.
- AI-first engineering and LLMs. You use Claude Code every day and understand how large language models work: tokens, context windows, cost, structured output, embeddings and retrieval. You have built production features with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, including tool calling and evaluations, and designed agentic services with clear guardrails and human review. You set our AI-first operating model, covering approved models and frameworks, Claude Code conventions, evaluation and release gates, and governance.
- Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely in writing and in conversation, and you adapt your message for engineers, product leaders and executives. You understand complex problems quickly, ask the right questions and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and cultures, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly between time zones. You are proactive: you spot problems and opportunities before you are asked, propose solutions and innovations of your own, and drive them through without waiting for instructions.
- Leadership and behaviours. You lead without authority and influence engineering heads and teams across the organisation. You define the hiring bar for each level, calibrate interviewers and give Talent Acquisition clear screening criteria. You mentor senior engineers into technical leaders, build an engineering practice that does not depend on you, and hold the bar under commercial pressure. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.

Preferred qualifications:

- B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
- Experience maintaining a widely used open-source library.
- Experience with multi-region and disaster-recovery architecture.
- Experience mapping engineering controls to SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
- Experience with multi-agent systems and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
- Experience running an engineering-productivity measurement programme.
- Experience in the second backend language.

About the job:

WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Principal Engineer you own architecture and engineering standards for full-stack engineering across teams. You stay hands-on and set the bar for hiring. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.

Responsibilities:

- Own the architecture of TypeScript and Node.js or Python systems across multiple teams, and set the technical roadmap that takes them from where they are today to where the platform needs to be.
- Stay hands-on: write, review and ship production code, lead by example on test-driven development, profiling and AI-first delivery, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself.
- Set and maintain our engineering standards for API design, data, reliability, security, observability and testing; publish them as a style guide and reference architectures, certify teams against them, and decide on exceptions.
- Review designs and architecture decision records across teams, challenge assumptions, and make sure decisions are made on evidence and recorded with their trade-offs.
- Decide, with Platform Engineering, how we use AWS Lambda and Kubernetes, and own the cost, capacity and reliability consequences of those choices.
- Lead the response to the most serious production incidents and performance problems, find the root cause and make sure it does not happen again.
- Drive large-scale change such as migrations, framework upgrades and deprecations across many codebases through to completion, including switching off what has been replaced.
- Define how we build with AI: the models, SDKs and agentic frameworks we use, how Claude Code is used day to day, and how AI-written code and AI features are evaluated and released.
- Work with product, engineering and business leaders in other regions to shape what we build, turn business goals into technical plans, and make trade-offs visible.
- Set the hiring bar for full-stack engineers at every level, write interview material, calibrate interviewers and give recruiters clear screening criteria.
- Mentor senior engineers, grow the next generation of technical leaders, and build a community of practice through reviews, talks and knowledge sharing.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

- Parallel delivery: Do not independently prioritize, defer or queue assigned feedback. Decompose work into independently executable tasks, distribute them across engineers and use AI agents where appropriate to drive concurrent delivery.
- Zero backlog: Maintain a target of zero unstarted or unattended assigned feedback. Actively drive all open items to closure and resolve dependencies and blockers without allowing work to accumulate.

description:

We want to hire ambitious, and value-adding talent into Modulr, one of the fastest growing payments businesses in the UK and Europe. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high-growth environment with a fast-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems across the entire technology stack.

About Us

At Modulr our mission is to move money efficiently to power business productivity. We are building a new digital payments service to make money flow more efficiently through businesses and the economy. This is a new type of payments account that is built for businesses that need faster, easier and more reliable ways to move money.

Our flexible platform and innovative approach allows our customers to utilise our payments account instead of a traditional bank account. Our accounts come with a sort code and account number, access to payment systems (eg Faster Payments and Visa) and everything our customers need from a payments account. They can instantly open as many accounts as they need, automate how they make and receive payments as well as the reconciliation processes these create. All in real time, 24/7 through their own systems utilising our API that integrates into any platform.

Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by payments giants PayPal Ventures and FIS Ventures, as well as startup and scale up specialists Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog and Highland Europe which enables us to leverage their resources and expertise to drive our growth initiatives. These partnerships provide us with the necessary provisions to propel our business to new heights.

Modulr values

- Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile.
- Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest.
- Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey.
- Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite.

The Role

The Full Stack Lead Engineer is a vital role within Modulr, where you will be responsible for building an autonomous, high performing engineering squad to foster an environment where decisions are delegated, made and communicated effectively. You will drive technical strategy with a strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI backend development while remaining deeply hands-on with core development. the architecture and implementation of robust, scalable backend systems using FastAPI, cloud infrastructure on AWS, and coordinate full-stack solutions with frontend teams.

- Collaborate with Frontend, DevOps, and Product teams to deliver integrated solutions, ensuring seamless API integration between backend and frontend.
- Drive agile practices and conduct productive ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, retros), promoting continuous improvement and team autonomy.
- Drive hiring and recruitment, conducting technical interviews, assessments, and candidate evaluations while representing Modulr's engineering culture and values.
- Report on squad progress, outcomes, and technical achievements to leadership; share knowledge and best practices across the broader Engineering organisation.

- Self-directed and proactive, with a drive to continuously learn and innovate in Python and backend technologies.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.

This role is a part of Bluehost's innovation team, the group building the AI-native backbone of our platform while the rest of the business scales around us. You'll design async, production-grade backend systems that treat AI as a first-class citizen: multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and provider-agnostic LLM integration, all woven into products millions of small businesses depend on. We want a true go-getter who can take an idea from whiteboard to production without waiting to be told how.

What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark

- Design and scale async REST/WebSocket APIs in Python (FastAPI or similar), using dependency injection, type hints, and clean, vertical-slice architecture 
- Implement multi-agent workflows (sequential, concurrent, and handoff patterns) to route work among specialized LLM agents 
- Integrate multiple LLM providers behind a provider-agnostic layer, enabling A/B testing and cost-aware routing rather than hard-coding a single vendor 
- Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines against vector stores such as pgvector, Chroma, or a managed vector search service 
- Design schemas and evolve data models (SQLAlchemy/SQLModel-style ORM plus migrations) that support both traditional application logic and AI-driven features 
- Instrument services with structured logs, distributed tracing, and cost/latency metrics, holding a real bar for p95 response time under production load 
- Maintain end-to-end CI/CD ownership, lint, type-check, test, package, and deploy, so releases are boring and safe 
- Champion AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and set the guardrails the team works inside: how generated code gets reviewed, how provenance and licensing are checked, and what customer data may enter a prompt 
- Move ideas from concept to production fast, with real ownership over architecture and outcomes, not just tickets 

Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed

- 5+ years building production backend systems in Python, with real async I/O experience 
- Hands-on experience designing and scaling REST or async APIs, including dependency injection and clean service architecture 
- Practical experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, or similar) and building AI-readiness into backend systems from the ground up 
- Real experience with vector databases and RAG-style retrieval architectures, not just reading about them 
- Strong relational database skills: schema design, query optimization, and migration discipline 
- AI-augmented delivery: you use AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and can say which models suit which problems and where you don't use them. You review AI-generated code knowing its failure modes, and you have set the guardrails others work inside — review expectations for generated code, provenance and licensing checks, and clear boundaries for what customer data enters a prompt and what a security or compliance review will ask for. 
- End-to-end CI/CD ownership, from build and test through packaging and deployment 
- A self-starting, go-getter mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and owning a problem until it's actually solved 
- Bonus: experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar) and LLM cost/observability tooling 

Why You'll Love Us

- We’ve evolved: We provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment. 
- Work-life balance: Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well. 
- We celebrate one another’s differences: We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally. 
- We care about you: At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
- Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost #OTOD!   

#Bluehost

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An Overview Of This Role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Scanning team, you'll help developers find and fix security issues in their code by contributing to the static analysis engine that finds them.

Your work spans both the engine and the tools we use to evaluate it. You'll extend how the engine models programs, from parsing source code and resolving symbols to building call graphs and tracking tainted data across files and languages. You'll also build and apply tooling to test its findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, measuring both false positives and missed vulnerabilities.

We build the engine with artificial intelligence (AI) agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction. You'll implement component specifications within the team's architecture, working with engineers and AI agents. Good judgment about when to trust agent output, and when to bring it to human review, is central to the role.

What You'll Do

- Extend the program model, including parsing, symbol resolution, intermediate representations, call graphs, and taint and data-flow analysis, to support new languages and frameworks.
- Build and apply AI-assisted tooling to implement, review, and validate engine changes and findings, in collaboration with the team's technical leadership. Measure detection quality against known vulnerabilities, judging changes primarily on false positive and false negative rates.
- Develop static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP), along with test fixtures that demonstrate they work.
- Implement component specifications with engineers and AI agents through phased plans and small, reviewable changes. Keep specifications and code in sync.
- Improve the harness, agent instructions, and skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy. Use separate coding and reviewing agents, performance checks, application programming interface (API) checks, and dependency checks, and escalate risky changes to human review.

title: Software Engineer III
description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care. 

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary Of Position

Teladoc Health is seeking a Senior/Mid Software Engineer – Mirth / Healthcare Interoperability to join our engineering organization and build, enhance, and support healthcare integrations that enable the secure and reliable exchange of clinical and operational data.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on Mirth Connect, HL7v2, and healthcare interoperability. The engineer will design and implement complex integration workflows, troubleshoot production interfaces, collaborate with internal teams and external healthcare partners, and contribute to the evolution of our integration platform.

The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in Mirth Connect and HL7v2, combined with solid software engineering, integration, debugging, and production support skills. Experience with FHIR, EHR/EMR integrations, and healthcare interoperability standards is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

Healthcare Integration & Engineering

- Design, develop, configure, test, deploy, and maintain healthcare interfaces using Mirth Connect. 
- Develop complex integration workflows for HL7v2 message parsing, transformation, validation, routing, and delivery. 
- Develop reusable and maintainable JavaScript-based transformations and business logic within Mirth Connect. 
- Integrate healthcare systems using TCP/MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, SFTP, and other integration protocols. 
- Translate business and technical requirements into robust, scalable, and production-ready integration solutions. 
- Collaborate with internal engineering teams, healthcare organizations, and external vendors to design and implement interfaces. 
- Contribute to the design and evolution of healthcare interoperability solutions and integration architecture. 
- Identify opportunities to improve integration performance, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency. 

Production Support & Reliability

- Monitor and support production healthcare interfaces and integration workflows. 
- Diagnose and resolve issues involving message processing, transformation, routing, connectivity, certificates, and downstream systems. 
- Troubleshoot network and protocol-level issues across MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SFTP. 
- Perform root-cause analysis for production incidents and implement sustainable corrective actions. 
- Improve interface reliability through effective logging, monitoring, alerting, error handling, and operational automation. 
- Participate in an on-call rotation supporting critical production integrations. 
- Ensure integration solutions meet appropriate security, reliability, and operational standards. 

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

- Partner with product managers, architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors to deliver healthcare integration solutions. 
- Communicate technical designs, issues, risks, and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
- Participate in technical design and architecture reviews. 
- Conduct code and configuration reviews and promote standards for secure, scalable, and maintainable integration development. 
- Create and maintain technical documentation, including interface specifications, mapping documents, design documents, and operational runbooks. 
- Mentor engineers and serve as a technical resource for Mirth Connect, HL7v2, and healthcare interoperability. 
- Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, and continuous improvement across the integration platform. 

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of professional software engineering and/or healthcare integration experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience developing and supporting Mirth Connect integrations. 
- Strong, practical knowledge of HL7v2, including message structure, segments, fields, components, repetitions, acknowledgments, and common message types. 
- Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Mirth Connect channels, including connectors, filters, transformers, and JavaScript. 
- Strong experience with TCP/MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SFTP. 
- Proven ability to troubleshoot connectivity, message delivery, transformation, routing, and downstream system issues in production environments. 
- Working knowledge of JavaScript for Mirth transformations and integration logic. 
- Understanding of SSL/TLS, certificates, keystores/truststores, and secure endpoint configuration. 
- Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases. 
- Experience with software development lifecycle practices, source control, testing, deployment, and production support. 
- Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external partners. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with FHIR, including FHIR resources, APIs, and integration patterns. 
- Experience with EHR/EMR integrations and healthcare information exchange. 
- Experience with CCDA/C-CDA. 
- Familiarity with XDS.b and XCA. 
- Experience working with healthcare interoperability standards and architectures. 
- Experience developing or integrating with REST APIs and web services. 
- Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases. 
- Experience with other healthcare interface engines such as Rhapsody, Corepoint, Cloverleaf, or similar technologies. 
- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
- Mirth Connect Certified Developer (MCCD) certification. 
- Participation in Mirth Connect, healthcare interoperability, or open-source technical communities.

title: AI Native Builder - Frontend
description:
Who We Are

Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.

Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.

The Team

You'll work on three things together: Atlan's context layer, the platforms that make it usable, and the agents that run on top of it.

The platform handles the things agents need to be trusted in production: knowing which agents and skills exist, understanding what happened during a run, evaluating how well they performed, and controlling access and cost.

Then there are the agents themselves. Each one is built to do a specific job, either for our customers or for our own teams. These aren't demos sitting on a slide. We already have an agent our CSMs rely on, three GTM agents that replace around 3,000 manual calls, an agent that watches changes across atlan.com, and an agent that monitors our other agents.

We share what we're learning through Becoming Frontier.

You'll own the frontend, but you won't be limited to the frontend. We use AI heavily in how we build, and we expect you to be comfortable working across the stack.

We work in small "two-slice" teams. You'll typically own an initiative with one or two other people. There's no large team around you to hand work off to, so you'll have a lot of ownership over how something gets built.

What will you do?

- Take a 0→1 idea all the way to production. Figure out the problem, write the spec when one doesn't exist, make the architecture decisions and build it.
- Own the frontend experience for agents. Build the interfaces people use to find, run, inspect and approve agents. Care about rendering performance and build components that other engineers can build on.
- Work beyond the frontend. Use coding agents to navigate unfamiliar backend code, make changes and validate their output rather than blindly trusting what they generate.
- Build agents with the people who will actually use them. Demo early, learn from real usage and put the agent into the workflow where the work already happens.
- Design for things going wrong. Think through what happens when a tool fails, context is missing, an agent isn't confident or a human needs to take over.
- Make agent behavior observable. Connect traces and evals to the version of the agent that produced them, and treat changes in quality as regressions worth investigating.
- Build AI-native yourself. Use coding agents as part of your daily workflow, while keeping the engineering and architectural bar high.
- Share what you learn. Turn useful patterns into skills, reference architectures and demos that other engineers can build on.

What makes you a great match for us?

Must have

- Strong frontend fundamentals. You've shipped production UIs using React, Vue or something similar with TypeScript, and you've dealt with hard problems around rendering performance, component systems or framework migrations.
- You've taken 0→1 products from an idea to production, often without a neatly defined spec.
- You've shipped agents or LLM-powered systems that real people use, and can debug failures down to the context, tool call or decision that caused them.
- You use evals to understand where agents fail and improve them based on real user impact.
- You use coding agents regularly and hold their output to the same engineering bar as your own.
- You're a critical optimist. You can get excited about new technology without taking it at face value, and you're comfortable reasoning from first principles.
- You enjoy owning an initiative with a small number of people rather than working as one part of a large team.

Strong bonus

- React, Vite and TypeScript, which is our current stack.
- Experience with MCP, A2A, agent frameworks, LLM gateways or agent observability.
- Experience as a founding engineer or working at an early-stage startup.
- A public trail of work, such as an active GitHub, npm packages or open-source contributions, that gives us a sense of how you build.

This probably isn't for you if...

You want to manage a large team, prefer having a well-defined backlog handed to you, only want to work on the frontend, or are still waiting to start working with AI.

We're looking for someone who wants to build with this technology now.

Why Atlan?

Joining Atlan Means Being Part Of a Global Movement To Help Data Teams Do Their Life’s Best Work. Here’s What You Can Expect

- Competitive Compensation: We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.
- AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.

title: Back End Developer(Node.js / TypeScript / AWS Serverless)
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

  

The role is primarily focused on Node.js and TypeScript development using AWS serverless services. Strong

hands-on experience with Node.js, TypeScript and AWS is mandatory. Java experience is advantageous but not

mandatory.

  

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

  

**1. Node.js and TypeScript on AWS Lambda - Mandatory**

Develop backend services and AWS Lambda handlers using Node.js and TypeScript.

Build and maintain reliable serverless integrations using modern TypeScript practices.

Work with ES modules, class-validator and class-transformer.

Build and bundle services using esbuild or Webpack.

Write automated tests using Jest, Nock or aws-sdk-client-mock.

  

**2. Event-Driven AWS Serverless - Mandatory**

Build and deploy solutions using AWS SAM and AWS CloudFormation.

Work with Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS and Amazon DynamoDB.

Manage configuration and secrets using AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and AWS Secrets

Manager.

Design for retries, idempotency, batch processing and operational resilience. Experience with AWS Lambda

Powertools is advantageous.

  

**3. Third-Party API Integration and Payment Systems**

Integrate with external REST APIs and handle authentication, pagination, rate limits and error scenarios.

Receive and verify webhooks, including callouts secured with Basic Authentication.

Understand core subscription billing and payment concepts such as accounts, subscriptions, invoices,

payment methods and gateway flows such as PayPal.

  

**4. Java - Nice to Have**

Experience developing backend services or AWS Lambda functions using Java 17 or later is advantageous

but not mandatory.

Familiarity with Maven, JUnit and Mockito is useful.

Exposure to Oracle databases through JDBC and encryption using javax.crypto is beneficial.

  

**HIGHLY VALUABLE EXPERIENCE**

  

**ZUORA EXPERIENCE**

Experience with Zuora REST APIs, Orders, Rate Plans and data queries across regional tenants is highly

valued but not mandatory.

Candidates with experience in Chargebee, Recurly, Stripe Billing or Salesforce Billing are also well aligned,

as the underlying subscription and billing concepts are transferable.

The successful candidate will receive onboarding support, an internal wrapper library and domain

documentation.

  

**USEFUL BUT NOT CRITICAL**

Python / general scripting

Ability to read and modify Python scripts used for maintenance, data imports and data changes is useful.

Deep Python or C# expertise is not required. Strength in one scripting or general-purpose programming

language is sufficient.

  

**HOW WE WORK**

Infrastructure as code is used across all environments.

Changes are reviewed through pull requests and supported by automated tests.

Security is built in by default, with least-privilege access and no secrets stored in source code.

New developers are onboarded into the billing domain. Curiosity about subscriptions and payments is more

important than prior Zuora experience.

  

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

A hands-on backend engineer with strong, mandatory experience in Node.js, TypeScript and AWS serverless

development. The candidate should be comfortable building AWS Lambda services, developing reliable

integrations, writing automated tests and taking operational ownership. Java experience is advantageous but

not required. An interest in learning the subscription billing domain is essential.

title: Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Full-Stack Engineer Python, FastAPI, React & Distributed Data Systems**

  

Employment Type

Full-time

  

Experience Required

**3+ years** of professional full-stack or backend engineering experience (with meaningful React front-end work)

  

About the Role:

We are looking for a **Senior Full-Stack Engineer** who is equally comfortable designing **high-performance Python backends** and building **polished, responsive React front-ends**. You will own features end-to-end from the UI component to the FastAPI endpoint, the data model across **MariaDB/PostgreSQL and Cassandra**, and the **Kafka-based event pipelines** that keep our platform fast, scalable, and reliable.

  

This role is for someone who thinks in terms of **throughput, latency, backpressure, idempotency, consumer lag, and graceful failure** and who also cares deeply about **accessible, maintainable, well-tested UI**.

Key Responsibilities:

Front-End (React)

Build **responsive, accessible, performant React applications** using modern hooks, component composition, and state management. Integrate with **REST APIs (FastAPI)** handle loading/error/empty states, optimistic updates, pagination, and caching. Write **reusable, testable components** with clean separation of concerns; manage forms and validation. Optimize **rendering performance** (memoization, code-splitting, lazy loading, virtualization for large lists). Collaborate with design on UX; ensure cross-browser and responsive behavior.

  

API & Service Development:

Design, build, and maintain **RESTful APIs using FastAPI** with clean, versioned contracts and proper HTTP semantics. Write correct **async and sync endpoints** — understanding when to use the event loop vs. the threadpool and never blocking the loop. Implement **dependency injection, Pydantic schemas, response models, authentication, rate limiting, and idempotency**. Build **streaming and paginated responses** for large payloads; avoid memory spikes.

  

Data Layer (Relational + Distributed):

Design **normalized schemas and high-quality indexes** in **MariaDB / PostgreSQL**; tune slow queries using EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS). Manage **transactions, isolation levels, connection pooling, and deadlock mitigation**. Model data in **Cassandra** around **query patterns** — designing partition and clustering keys that avoid hot and unbounded partitions. Reason about **consistency levels** (QUORUM, etc.) and the trade-offs between strong and eventual consistency.

  

Messaging & Event Streaming (Kafka):

Design and operate **Kafka producers and consumers** in Python — topic design, **partitioning strategy, key selection, and ordering guarantees**. Tune **consumer groups, offsets, rebalancing, and consumer lag**; ensure **at-least-once / exactly-once** semantics where required. Apply **idempotency and deduplication** for retried/replayed messages to prevent duplicate side effects. Handle **schema evolution** and **dead-letter queues** for poison messages. Integrate Kafka with **worker pipelines** for decoupled, scalable workloads.

  

Concurrency, Workers & Scalability:

Build **bounded producer–consumer** pipelines with **threads, queues, and worker pools**, including **graceful shutdown and backpressure**. Offload CPU-bound and slow work to **process pools and message brokers** (Kafka/Celery/RabbitMQ/Redis). Make asynchronous, retried operations **idempotent** to prevent duplicate side effects (e.g., payments). Scale services **horizontally** with stateless design, shared state stores, load balancing, and caching.

  

Reliability & Quality:

Write **tests** (backend and frontend), participate in code reviews. Instrument services with **logging, metrics, and tracing**; monitor **Kafka consumer lag** and diagnose production issues. Contribute to **CI/CD**, deployment, and operational runbooks.

  

Required Skills & Experience:

**Must have (3+ years hands-on):**

**Python** — strong command of async/await, threading, concurrency, and the GIL's practical implications.

**FastAPI** — path operations, Depends, Pydantic models, response\_model, BackgroundTasks, HTTPException.

**React** — hooks, component design, state management, API integration, performance optimization, testing (Jest/React Testing Library). **JavaScript/TypeScript** — strong modern JS; TypeScript preferred. **MariaDB and/or PostgreSQL** — schema design, indexing, query optimization, transactions, isolation levels, connection pooling. **Cassandra (or comparable wide-column NoSQL)** — data modeling by query pattern, partition/clustering keys, consistency levels.

**Kafka** — producers/consumers in Python, topics/partitions, consumer groups, offsets, delivery semantics, and lag management.

**API design** — REST, status codes, idempotency, versioning, pagination, caching (ETag/If-None-Match).

**Concurrency & workers** — thread pools, bounded queues, backpressure, graceful shutdown, background job processing.

**High-performance & scalable systems** — stateless services, horizontal scaling, caching, read replicas

  

**Nice to have:**

**Next.js**, SSR/SSG, and React Server Components. Frontend state/data libraries (React Query / TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, Zustand).

**Kafka Streams / ksqlDB**, Schema Registry, **Kafka Connect**.

**Redis** **SQLAlchemy** (sync and async), Alembic migrations.

**Docker, Kubernetes**, and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), plus managed Kafka (MSK/Confluent Cloud). Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Sentry); Kafka monitoring (Burrow, Kafka Exporter). Familiarity with **event-driven**, **outbox**, and **CQRS** patterns.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of technocrats focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

  

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

  

As we continue to grow, were always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

  

**Job Overview**

The Software Engineer is responsible for coding, testing and implementing products for our HRS Platform Team, which is increasingly focused on agentic and AI-driven engineering. This role is for engineers who have meaningfully adapted their day-to-day workflow (design, coding, testing and debugging) around AI-assisted and agentic development tools and who can bring that fluency to raise the bar for the broader team. Responsibilities include reviewing functional and technical requirements, performing research, designing solutions and developing code in a variety of programming languages for a Web + AI -based enterprise application.

  

**Key responsibilities**

  

**Engineering**

* Design, build, test and ship full-stack features in C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core Web APIs, SQL and a modern web front end.
* Write code that meets design specifications, follows team standards, and is easy to maintain.
* Review functional and technical requirements, research options, and propose designs. Write or contribute to design documents.
* Join design sessions and code reviews.

**AI-assisted engineering**

* Use AI-assisted and agentic development tools in daily work, including code generation, coding agents, AI code review and test generation, to improve both speed and quality.
* Get reliable, production-quality output from agentic tools through good context engineering: agent instructions, skills, repo conventions and guardrails.
* Coach teammates on effective and responsible AI tool use, including review discipline, security and data-handling rules.

**AI in the product**

* Build and integrate LLM features into Tracker I-9, such as document extraction, RAG, agents and tool use, using Azure OpenAI and related Azure AI services.
* Add observability, evaluation and cost and latency monitoring to AI features. Make sure they meet compliance, privacy and security requirements for employee PII.

**Quality and delivery**

* Do unit, automation and peer testing so features ship fully tested.
* Ship through CI/CD on Azure DevOps, and help improve pipelines and engineering processes.
* Document your work. Give demos, training sessions and presentations when needed.
* Work with product, QA, hosting, infrastructure and DBA teams so project requirements are met.
* Recommend refactoring, process improvements, tools and new AI-driven development practices.

  

**Required skills and experience**

* 3+ years of professional software development, mostly in C# and .NET (.NET Core).
* Strong object-oriented design, design patterns and SOLID principles.
* ASP.NET Core and MVC, building RESTful Web APIs, and validation libraries such as FluentValidation.
* 3+ years of SQL and relational databases (Azure SQL / SQL Server), including query tuning, plus an ORM such as Entity Framework Core or Dapper.
* Front-end development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework (Angular preferred). Experience with Bootstrap and jQuery is useful for legacy modules.
* Cloud development on Microsoft Azure: App Service, Functions, Storage, Key Vault and Managed Identity.
* CI/CD and Git on Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Boards).
* Unit testing and mocking with NUnit or xUnit and Moq or NSubstitute. Familiarity with test automation.
* Authentication and security protocols, including OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and secure coding practices (OWASP).
* **Hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools** such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similar in your normal workflow. You should be able to explain specifically how they changed the way you design, code, test and debug.
* Understanding of how to manage agent instructions, skills, context and guardrails to get consistent, production-quality results from agentic tools.
* At least one shipped project where AI-assisted development clearly sped up delivery or improved quality.
* Strong logical reasoning, predictable delivery, and clear written and spoken communication.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
**When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.**  
   
At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

**About Parexel**

  

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.

  

**About the Role**

We are seeking a **Software Engineer II (Software Test Engineer)** with a focus on life sciences technology to join our team. As a Software Engineer II, you will apply hands-on software testing expertise to help deliver reliable applications that advance clinical research and new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in software quality and reliability for the applications that support clinical research.

  

You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to testing activities from requirement walkthroughs through test reporting. Responsibilities include designing and executing functional, regression, and integration testing, tracking defects to resolution, and partnering with Product Owners and Developers, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence product quality.

  

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through rigorous test design, clear defect management, and close collaboration with Product Owners and Developers. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Software Engineer II can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research technology.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop test scenarios, test cases and scripts, and test data that reflect application requirements and functionality.
* Execute functional, regression, and integration testing in line with defined procedures to verify application quality.
* Analyze application requirements and functionality to shape effective test coverage.
* Identify, document, track, and support the resolution of defects, helping teams deliver stable, high-quality software.
* Prepare and maintain test documentation, including test execution evidence and test summary reports.
* Participate in requirement walkthroughs and discussions with Product Owners and Developers.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Developers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve testing-related questions.

  

**You'll thrive in this role if you bring**

* Strengths in problem-solving, analytical thinking, and managing multiple priorities.
* An interest in life sciences and clinical research, with an appreciation for the quality standards of regulated environments.
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly.
* A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail.
* Comfort working with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, defect and test management tools, and AI-assisted tools.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance.
* Familiarity with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with defect management and test management tools.
* Basic knowledge of Java, SQL, and JavaScript.
* Basic understanding of artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI technologies and their application in software testing and quality assurance activities.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and organization skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Life sciences domain knowledge.
* Knowledge or hands-on experience with Oracle Argus, ArisG (LifeSphere), or Veeva.
* Knowledge of Good Practice (GxP), computer system validation and computer software assurance (CSV/CSA), Good Automated Manufacturing Practice 5 (GAMP 5), and Title 21 Code of Federal Regulations Part 11 (21 CFR Part 11).
* Experience using AI-assisted tools for test case design, test documentation, defect analysis, and productivity improvement.

  

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

  

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Software Engineer II
description:
PDI helps convenience store retailers and petroleum wholesale marketers worldwide thrive in a digital economy with enterprise management software. Over 1,500 customers operating more than 200,000 locations trust PDI to optimize their operations, whether they are a single site, multi-site, dealer or a franchise operator. PDI s enterprise software, wholesale and logistics management software solutions and retail back-office systems have been designed around the evolving needs of customers for more than 35 years. We re-imagine enterprise management to help our customers transform their business and deliver exceptional experiences. Backed by the investment of TA Associates, Genstar and Insight Venture Partners, PDI is embarking upon an aggressive expansion strategy through internal investment in development as well as intensive M&A activity. The result will be a broader, more powerful, international company that serves customers across the entire supply chain, from wholesalers to retailers, and every stop in between.

Role Overview:

If you love to design scalable fault-tolerant systems that can run efficiently with high performance and are eager to learn new technologies and develop new skills, then we have a great opportunity for you: join our PDI family and work closely with other talented PDI engineers to deliver solutions that delight our customers every day!  
You will play a key role in designing and building our market leading software products as we drive to continuously increase our cloud maturity and mobility. You will be working as a key part of an agile team to design, build, test, and support PDIs enterprise software solutions. You will review, recommend & implement system enhancements that will improve the quality, performance, and maintainability of our products. You will be responsible for contributing to an always improving Engineering environment by ensuring all stakeholders (engineers, architects, product owners, SREs, IT Ops ) are informed of status and supported in their roles.  
Job

Job Responsibilities:

* AI-Powered POS, EPS & Forecourt Development: Build intelligent systems across Point of Sale, Electronic Payment Systems, and Forecourt management using C# and .NET, incorporating real-time analytics, payment integration, inventory intelligence, and multi-step automation workflows for retail, hospitality, and fuel environments.
* Product Innovation & AI Integration: Develop next-generation ASP.NET Core platforms with generative AI features including predictive pump management, fraud detection, and forecourt monitoring optimized for performance, UX, and safety compliance.  
  Intelligent System Architecture: Leverage LLMs and multimodal models within .NET service architectures using SignalR for real-time features and Entity Framework Core for data access, delivering context-aware experiences across POS, EPS, and forecourt domains.
* Payment & Forecourt Integration: Develop and maintain integrations with payment terminals (ISO 8583, EMV, NFC) and forecourt controllers (Gilbarco, Wayne) using IFSF, OPT, and serial/TCP protocols, ensuring end-to-end PCI-DSS, compliance and reliable pump authorization workflows.
* Backend API & Cloud Deployment: Design RESTful and event-driven APIs using ASP.NET Core Web API; deploy and maintain .NET applications on Azure using Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling for high-availability transactional workloads.
* Testing, UI & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Write automated tests (xUnit/ NUnit / MSTest) and contribute to agent evaluation frameworks; build UI components using React as needed; work closely with product, UX, and operations teams to translate workflows into production-ready solutions.

Job Requirements:

* Core Experience: 3-5 years of professional software engineering with demonstrated ownership in production systems; experience in transactional, high-availability, retail, payment, or forecourt environments is a strong plus.
* C# & .NET Stack: Strong proficiency in C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, dependency injection, and NuGet package management.
* Payment & Forecourt Protocols: Familiarity with ISO 8583, EMV, NFC, and PCI-DSS compliance; familiarity with forecourt integration (IFSF, OPT, pump authorization) and serial/TCP communication protocols is recommended.
* Agentic Systems Mastery: Proven hands-on experience building intelligent, automation-driven systems across any platform/product including workflow orchestration for multi-step transactions.
* AI & Backend Integration: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs or AI services into backend systems, including prompt engineering, RAG, and automation workflows  
  Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying .NET applications to AWS with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.
* Web APIs & Real-Time Communication: Experience building scalable APIs with RESTful design, authentication patterns, and SignalR for live event streaming across transactions and forecourt operations.
* Testing & Security: Strong test-driven development practices (xUnit/ NUnit/ MSTest); solid understanding of secure coding, PCI-DSS, and protection against injection/tampering in high-value transactions.
* Additional Skills: Proficiency with Visual Studio/VS Code and Git workflows; familiarity with Python, JavaScript, or Pascal (Delphi); knowledge of vector databases or data pipelines for analytics is a plus.
* Soft Skills: Strong communication and collaboration ability; growth mindset; effective cross-domain teamwork with initiative-taking and good judgment about when to seek guidance.

Behavioral Competencies:

* Ensures Accountability
* Manages Complexity
* Communicates Effectively
* Balances Stakeholders

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. You ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about-locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

**What Were Looking For:**

Designs, develops, analyzes, and maintains test automation for the organization s products and systems. Performs system integration of software and hardware to ensure throughput, consistency, and compliance with quality standards. Develops, validates, and tests software functionality and associated documentation. Work is reviewed for overall adequacy, but allows for greater independence in day-to-day responsibilities. Follows established processes and contributes to improving existing methodologies.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Designs, develops, and maintains automated tests for Aurora Focus desktop (Electron) and backend APIs as part of a larger project, ensuring alignment with project objectives and timelines
* Creates and maintains test cases and results documentation in TestRay
* Participates in code reviews and provides constructive feedback
* Contributes to testing of software solutions on physical devices in a lab. Analyzes results and conducts root cause analysis to diagnose and resolve issues, including nightly automation failures
* Recommends and implements solutions to complex technical challenges, ensuring compliance with quality processes and standards
* Modifies and enhances existing software by improving functionality, scalability, and performance to meet evolving business needs
* Proactively seeks out opportunities to enhance performance and productivity by recommending new tools or methodologies
* Demonstrates sound judgment to determine appropriate actions for software development and testing tasks

* Builds productive working relationships within the team, across organizational units, and with external customers
* Occasionally interacts with inter-organizational and external stakeholders to address project related needs or resolve issues

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Advanced Degree in a relevant field is also acceptable
* 3+ years of relevant software engineering or test automation experience (JavaScript/TypeScript, Jest or similar), including testing applications that interact with embedded Linux devices.
* Equivalency: Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree

**Key Skills and Competencies:**

* Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, Jest, Puppeteer or Playwright, and Electron or web applications
* Strong understanding of software development life cycles (SDLC), including Agile or Scrum methodologies, in globally distributed teams

title: Software Engineer II
description:
### Job Summary

We are looking for a highly motivated **SRE Engineer II** to help build and maintain reliable, scalable, and high-performing systems. This role focuses on improving system availability, performance, and operational efficiency through automation, observability, and proactive reliability engineering practices. The ideal candidate has strong communication and interpersonal skills and enjoys working in a dynamic, team-oriented environment, along with a keen attention to detail, as well as the ability to collaborate with a diverse group of stakeholders.

Location: Bengaluru

### Responsibilities

* Design systems with resilience, graceful degradation, and capacity in mind.
* Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of large-scale cloud infrastructure across AWS environments
* Define and measure SLOs and SLIs that actually reflect what our customers feel.
* Use Datadog or Coralogix (logging, metrics, APM) together with CloudWatch to build signal-heavy, noise-light observability.
* Configure alerting and routing that reach engineers through incident.io, where we run incident management and on-call, so that when a human gets paged, it really matters.
* Continuously improve our incident lifecycle, from fast detection and solid triage, through clear communication, to blameless, actionable follow-ups.
* You will combine strong software fundamentals with reliability thinking so our systems are highly available, easy to debug, and a joy to work on.
* Monitor systems, troubleshoot issues, and resolve production incidents across microservices and distributed systems.
* Collaborate closely with software engineering teams to debug and resolve complex production problems.
* Participate in 24x7 on-call rotation supporting multi-cloud production environments.
* Monitor system metrics, application performance, and infrastructure health using observability tools.
* Own the incident management lifecycle, including detection, mitigation, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and post-incident reviews.
* Develop and maintain runbooks, automation, and operational processes to improve reliability and efficiency.
* Perform capacity planning using system usage and performance data.
* Drive SRE best practices, operational standards, and continuous improvement initiatives

### Essential Skills & Requirements

* A masters or bachelors degree in computer science or a related field, or related experience
* 4+ years of experience in an SRE or Software Engineering role.
* Successfully managed production environments at scale and understand that you need more than a for-loop to make it happen.
* A strong belief that observability is critically important to run highly available and performant services, not an optional nice-to-have.
* Must have experience in AWS systems and monitoring tools.
* Strong experience using SLOs, SLIs, and KPIs to guide decisions, prioritize work, and explain tradeoffs, not just decorate dashboards or slide decks.
* You've read (or written) part or all of the SRE book and contextualized it for different engineering teams and cultures, rather than treating it as a one-size-fits-all checklist.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI productivity tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and prompt engineering to reduce operational toil, accelerate incident root cause analysis, and optimize infrastructure-as-code workflows
* Hands-on experience shepherding services from design to production, through incident learnings, and into a state where on-call actually gets quieter over time.
* Experience tackling site-wide outages, learned the lessons, and know how to turn those lessons into concrete, technical, and process changes that make it much harder for the same problem to happen again.
* Passion for learning AI tools that will enhance the SRE process faster and help in reduction of manual tasks and mentoring engineers and leverage ways to improve reliability and metrics

description:
Finance teams lose days every month to manual, recurring work. We are building the fix, and we

need an engineer to own it.​

​

Plotigence is a finance engineering firm. Chartered accountants diagnose finance processes;

engineers turn them into production-grade software for enterprise clients. We build solutions from

the ground up and take over systems others started, then keep them running and audit-ready after

go-live.

The role

Full-Stack Engineer. You’ll own each project end to end, from the business requirements document to

secure software live in production. Some you’ll build from scratch; others start from someone else’s

code, which you’ll review, fix and take live. You’ll work directly with the founder and the team writing

the BRD.

The stack you’ll work with

- Backend: Node.js/TypeScript (Python a plus). REST APIs, business logic, background jobs

- Data: PostgreSQL schemas, migrations and SQL. Ledgers, mappings, audit trails

- Frontend: React or Next.js. Dashboards, review screens, approval flows

- Integrations: QuickBooks Online, Zoho Books, SAP, bank and payment platforms, Excel, CSV, PDF

- Security: role-based access, approval controls, SSO and MFA, OWASP Top 10, secrets management

- Deploy & run: AWS (ECS, RDS, S3) with Terraform, Azure; GitHub Actions, Sentry

- AI: LLM APIs with traceable data access; AI coding tools, with every line reviewed

You’re the right fit if you have

- 5+ years building software, with at least one product taken from idea to production

- Built REST APIs in Node.js/TypeScript and React/Next.js interfaces from a spec

- Designed relational schemas and written clean SQL and migrations

- Deployed and run an application on AWS yourself, with CI/CD, monitoring and alerts

- Found and fixed security problems in code

- Taken over a codebase you didn’t write and made it work

- Owned what you ship: tested, monitored, root causes fixed

- Bonus: QuickBooks or Zoho Books integrations, or support for a security audit or pen test (VAPT, ISO 27001, SOC 2)

Why you’ll like it here

- Real ownership: complete products, not tickets

- Breadth across clients, industries and stacks

- Learn how finance actually works

- Room to grow into a lead role

You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager of the BI Experiences team, which builds the analytics applications, dashboards and shared BI components used by Nike Direct and Marketplace business partners. You will be an individual contributor working alongside SWE III, Lead and Principal engineers, data engineers, designers and product managers. You will receive guidance from senior engineers, deliver well-scoped features with growing independence, and support SWE I engineers through code reviews and pairing.

  
  

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
--------------------------

We are looking for engineers with a frontend focus who are comfortable working across the stack and take ownership of the features they deliver.

* A minimum of 3+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years building production web applications with React and TypeScript.
* Experience building dashboards, analytics applications or other data-rich UIs, with hands-on charting experience using libraries such as Recharts, ECharts.
* Experience building or contributing to reusable components or shared libraries, with clear APIs and documentation.
* Working knowledge of state and data-fetching patterns (TanStack Query, Zustand) for global filters, cross-filtering and drill-downs.
* Working backend experience building APIs in Python (FastAPI) or Node.js.
* Solid testing discipline (Vitest/Jest, Playwright), including productive use of AI tools like GitHub Copilot.
* Familiarity with monorepos and CI/CD pipelines, including build caching and automated releases.
* Ability to contribute to technical designs through peer review, and to participate in observability and incident response for what you ship.
* Willingness to support junior engineers through code reviews and pairing.
* Strong written and verbal communication; able to collaborate with engineers, designers and product partners.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field — or equivalent experience.
* Preferred: experience with Turborepo or Nx, BI semantic layers, Databricks, data visualization best practices, or LLM-powered analytics.
  

  

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**
-----------------------

As a Software Engineer II on the BI Experiences team, you will build and deliver features across our analytics applications and shared BI components.

* You will build reusable BI components — KPI cards, trend charts, data tables and filter panels — used across Nike Direct and Marketplace dashboards.
* You will implement dashboard interactions such as shared filters, cross-filtering and drill-downs, and contribute to our report authoring experience.
* You will build and extend backend APIs that power these components, partnering with data engineers to deliver data in a consistent shape.
* You will contribute to technical design discussions and write design docs for well-scoped features.
* You will contribute to our monorepo, CI/CD and release tooling, including automated testing, so engineers can contribute to shared components safely.
* You will help monitor performance and production reliability of what you build, and participate in post-incident learning.
* You will support SWE I engineers through code reviews and pairing, and grow your own skills with guidance from senior engineers.
